scope: Bounded generic E!Store<T> with concrete finite Copy E, T:StoreElement and explicit successful-payload modes; author slice only.

win64.execution: Actual AMD64 PE through independent Wine prefix186; not native Windows certification

first_failures_preserved.cause: 0/10: finite enum error branch was given the entire union as constructor context; new source fixtures also omitted separators or joined > with =>. Production selects the actual error context; fixtures retain valid lexical separators.
7/3: nested argument hints omitted Error type variable traversal and prematurely treated unresolved T as a complete context. The existing variable walker now visits both written error arms.

38/1: missing-cleanup mutation removed a conditionally dead staging temporary DropErrorUnion, which Verify correctly accepted. Changed the fixture to remove the actually live final union cleanup. Verify production unchanged; original accepted candidate bytes and failure output remain.

remaining_boundaries: Default E!Store parameters/results or local annotations do not acquire an owning mode. give union and whole union replacement remain rejected.
Give results and incoming success payloads do not acquire create freshness through wrapping, extraction, forwarding or branch merging.
Arbitrary owning nested Sum, resources in the error arm, owning-union captures, lending escape and asynchronous behavior are outside this slice.
No claim of a complete symbolic checker for all language forms; existing closed expression and pattern profiles remain.

rust_four_goals.safety: Definition-time category/source checks, independent raw/Wire rechecks and actual failure cleanup verified in the finite slice; not a full-language proof.
rust_four_goals.runtime_memory: Direct existing IR and machine representation; actual frees balanced. No equivalent Rust runtime/RSS comparison.
rust_four_goals.expression_maintenance: One ordinary four-module generic collection library supports two distinct element layouts and fallible ownership; maintenance-cost comparison not measured.
rust_four_goals.compile_cost: NotMeasured; no compiler-speed claim or budget changes.
